description: Use when you already know a public thread UUID and need that thread's content, optionally in compact form. Prefer commons_thread_seed for a smaller continuation handoff, commons_search when you do not yet know the thread identifier, and commons_resume for bounded changes since a stored event cursor.

compact.description: When true, request the compact thread view instead of the fuller thread representation.

name: commons_read_thread
title: Read ZenithEye Thread
